owner_approval.scope: Three-year selected report history, necessary identity/FX/calculation context, normal raw expiry preserving reports and mandatory scoped erasure across layers. This delivery records the decision and current dependency review; no runtime/live action.

normal_report_retention.applies_to: Selected report-required fields plus necessary historical identity, FX and calculation/projection versions; not every field in a Dataset row.

field_selection.report_values: Necessary approved measurements at their approved native grain; exact units/decimals/support/observation/completeness preserved.
field_selection.historical_context: Only necessary owner/account/product/channel identity, original business date/timezone/source currency and actual applied FX/projection/formula/version and minimum immutable proof summary.

mandatory_erasure.installation: All in-scope merchant data layers including historical report/provenance/mapping; no blanket retention exemption for reports.
mandatory_erasure.customer: Relevant report rows must remain addressable after normal raw expiry; no success when scope is unknown.

implementation_acceptance: Selected report field and erasure-address classification reviewed at existing native grain.
Original verified source-to-report proof remains authenticated and owner-bound after normal raw/page/manifest expiry; no raw-body duplicate.
Report values, dates, currency, support/completeness, identity/FX/version context survive normal source cleanup.
Native source acceptance retains current fresh owner, receipt, AEAD, mapping, scope and expiry checks; historical proof is not fresh write authority.
Immutable three-calendar-year boundary tests including leap dates, timezones and replay/correction; no ingestion-based clock.
Mandatory installation and customer erasure after source cleanup, unrelated merchant isolation and no-reingestion remain proven.
